teaser: The invoice is paid before midnight. The friend on the phone still needs twenty more minutes of listening. You are a life path 8 who is also an ENFJ, and most weeks ask for both: the one closing the deal and the one holding the room steady while it closes. The 8 wants command of the material world — money, scale, the next rung. The ENFJ wants everyone in that world lifted along with you. What is particular to this crossing is how rarely those feel like separate jobs; the risk is that they start to feel like one job that never clocks out.
